summary: Iteration 14 addendum tested end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass (test_visits_addendum.py) covering is_minor validation (personal minor no cedula accepted; personal not-minor or absent flag rejected with correct Spanish detail; laboral still requires cedula & phone) and close_visit endpoint (success returns exit_at + duration_minutes; second close returns 400 'La visita ya está cerrada'; nonexistent -> 404; no permission -> 403; GET after close contains status='closed', exit_at, duration_minutes, closed_by; duration ~30 min for scheduled_at=now-30min). Frontend Playwright: (a) AgendarVisitaPage Personal tab shows visitor-0-minor checkbox, on check the cedula placeholder switches to 'Cédula escolar o del representante (opcional)' and label appends '(opcional para menores)'; on Laboral tab the checkbox is absent. (b) HistoricoVisitasPage renders visit-close-{visit_id} buttons on all non-closed rows (12 found); clicking after accepting window.confirm dialog triggers POST /visits/{id}/close, toast 'Visita cerrada · duración X min' shown, list reloads, the row now shows 'Finalizada' badge and the Cerrar button for that visit_id disappears. Duration column and Salida row in detail dialog present. Menor badge for is_minor visitors implemented in visitor cards.

minor.issue: duration_minutes can be negative when scheduled_at is in the future (observed -2673.6 min for a UI-created visit with default future scheduled_at). Consider clamping to max(0, ...) or using max(scheduled_at, created_at) as start. Also consider using created_at instead of scheduled_at, since scheduled_at may represent the planned arrival time — actual entry time is not tracked.

issues: Duration column may display negative values (e.g., '-2673.6 min') when visit was scheduled for future and closed early. Cosmetic; tie to backend fix above.

action_items: OPTIONAL: guard duration_minutes against negative values in POST /visits/{id}/close (use max(0, ...) or fallback to created_at if scheduled_at > exit_at).
critical_code_review_comments: close_visit uses scheduled_at as start time — this may be the planned arrival, not the actual entry. If entry is captured via kiosk selfies, consider using completed_at (when all selfies captured) as start for duration.

HistoricoVisitasPage: line 278 has data-testid='visit-close' (in the detail dialog Close button) — same prefix as row-level 'visit-close-{visit_id}'. Not a collision since exact-match differs, but consider renaming dialog button to 'visit-detail-close' for clarity.
server.py still 1954 lines — split into routers (visits, attendance, stats) recommended (also noted in iter12/13).
